en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide tree‑lined avenue with people walking and standing in the middle of the road. Large masonry buildings flank both sides. The lower part of the image has printed captions in Greek and French, including the name Argostoli and the street name translated as 'Rue des Prisons'. A circular stamp or logo appears on the left and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible at the bottom.
